en.headline: Hui says talks continue on London gold delivery standards
en.dek: The treasury secretary told a Sorrento conference that an Asian forum with the London association is set for Hong Kong next April.
body: Financial Services and the Treasury Secretary Christopher Hui said the government is discussing with the London Bullion Market Association how to put cooperation on good-delivery standards into practice. He said that if the cooperation goes ahead, internationally recognised standards could be built into Hong Kong's gold-market infrastructure and give the trade a clearer basis for taking part.

Speaking at the Global Precious Metals Conference in Sorrento, Italy, Hui also said the association will co-host an Asian forum in Hong Kong next April with the Hong Kong government and the Hong Kong Precious Metals Central Clearing Company. He described the forum as recognition of the pace of gold-market work in the city over the past two years.

Hui said work to link the clearing system with Hong Kong's real-time payment system, so that delivery and payment can be settled together, is in its final stage. He said the government is also using policy measures to encourage the private market to expand gold storage and raise refining capacity. He met the association's chairman, Peter Zöllner, to discuss trends in the global precious-metals market and closer links between the Hong Kong and London gold markets.

zh.headline: 許正宇：正與倫敦金銀市場協會談合格交割標準
zh.dek: 財庫局局長在意大利索倫托表示，若合作落實，有助把國際認可標準融入本港黃金市場基建。亞洲論壇訂明年4月在港合辦。
body: 財經事務及庫務局局長許正宇表示，政府正與倫敦金銀市場協會探討落實在合格交割標準上的合作。他說，若合作落實，將有助把國際認可標準融入香港黃金市場基建，為業界參與市場活動奠定基礎。
許正宇在意大利索倫托出席全球貴金屬會議時宣布，協會將與香港特區政府及香港貴金屬中央結算系統公司，於明年4月在香港合辦亞洲論壇。他認為這是對香港這兩年快速推進黃金市場發展的肯定。
許正宇說，把結算系統連結香港即時支付結算系統、以實現貨銀對付的工作已進入最後階段。政府亦正以不同政策舉措，推動私營市場擴充黃金倉儲容量及提升精煉產能。他並與協會主席Peter Zöllner會面，談及全球貴金屬市場趨勢，以及加強香港與倫敦黃金市場的聯通。
